description:
An intuitive diagram software with templates for any scenario.

EdrawMax is a powerful, all-in-one, and yet easy-to-use diagramming tool that enables users to visualize the ideas effortlessly. With EdrawMax, you can create and customize flowcharts, Venn diagrams, mind maps, organizational charts, Gantt charts, UML diagrams, electrical drawings, genograms, building plans, etc.
Upgraded Floor Plan Experience
Draw walls and dimension lines continuously for greater efficiency.
Set dimensions from the wall center, inner edge, or outer edge.
See live distances to nearby objects when moving or resizing walls, doors, and windows.
Improved alignment and snapping for more precise layouts.
New AI Floor Plan RecognitionUpload a drawing and let AI convert it into an editable floor plan. Walls, doors, windows, and text can all be edited. Access it from the Floor Plan tab on the Home page.
AI Agent Image Generation UpgradeAI Agent now supports the latest GPT Image 2 model for higher-quality, more expressive results.A new “Other Images” category and matching templates have also been added for more professional use cases.
Other Improvements
Template previews are now available on the Home page.
Right-click selected canvas content to copy it as an HD or Ultra HD image.
